  1. Description

Interface Message

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Subinterfaces:
Command, Event, GameCommand, HeartbeatCommand, HeartbeatEvent, LobbyCommand
All Known Implementing Classes:
CreateLobbyCommand, JoinLobbyCommand, LeaveLobbyCommand, MoveTotemCommand, PingCommand, PingEvent, PongCommand, PongEvent, ReconnectCommand, ResolveActionsCommand, SelectTotemCommand, SetUsernameCommand
public sealed interface Message extends Serializable permits Command, Event
Root sealed interface for all network messages exchanged between client and server. Subtypes are either Command (client → server) or Event (server → client).

Jackson polymorphic deserialization is configured via @JsonTypeInfo(Id.CLASS) at this level, but each subtype overrides it with @JsonTypeInfo(Id.NAME) for compact wire names. See JsonMessageCodecImpl for the resolution strategy.
